name: Whisperroot Deeps
introDiscord:
The ordinary kelp thins as roots older than the surrounding forest
rise from the Deeps. Some are wider than houses. Some have footprints.
introTwitch:
The ordinary kelp thins as roots older than the surrounding forest
rise from the Deeps. Some are wider than houses. Some have footprints.

whisperroot-deeps-approach.prompt:
Three paths wind between colossal roots disappearing into darkness
above and below.

left.message:
A wall of bark shifts.

Then stands.

You were not walking beside a root.

You were walking beside a Whisperroot Colossus.

right.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's tiny camp beneath a root large enough
to support a village.

Her note reads:

'Excellent shelter.

Root moved at breakfast.

Shelter rating adjusted.'

forward.message:
An offering basket hidden inside a root hollow contains Star Candies.
The hollow is large enough to qualify as a room.

whisperroot-deeps-depths.prompt:
Living rootways descend deeper beneath drifting Fae lights. Three paths
cross a forest floor made almost entirely from ancient roots.

left.message:
A tiny moonblossom pool rests in a crack between enormous roots.

Shizuki wrote:

'Found smallest thing in area.

Me.

Rude.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative pool untouched and continue feeling
appropriately small.

right.message:
One immense root lifts away from the path.

A Whisperroot Colossus straightens beneath it.

Apparently that root had legs.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a cache tucked between two roots. The Star
Candies look absurdly tiny beside the surrounding forest.

whisperroot-deeps-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds vanish almost entirely as three approaches descend
toward Primeval Root Cathedral.

left.message:
A shrine coffer rests inside a natural arch formed from two ancient
roots. The carvings on it are almost completely grown over.

right.message:
Restorative sap sits beneath Shizuki's note:

'If giant root moves:

1. Do not panic.
2. Move.
3. Panic after moving.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the medicine untouched and memorize the emergency order of
operations.

forward.message:
The final 'pillar' beside the Cathedral opens two glowing eyes.

Whisperroot Colossus.

You are very glad you did not lean against it.

boss-antechamber.name: Primeval Root Cathedral
boss-antechamber.prompt: The roots forming the Cathedral begin moving independently.

bossPromptDiscord:
Primeval Root Cathedral groans around you.

Ancient roots lift from the forest floor one after another.

What looked like the foundation of the entire chamber slowly rises into
a single colossal shape.

Every smaller Whisperroot Colossus kneels.

Use /yes to enter the Cathedral or /no to leave before the forest itself
stands completely upright.
bossPromptTwitch:
Primeval Root Cathedral groans around you.

Ancient roots lift from the forest floor one after another.

What looked like the foundation of the entire chamber slowly rises into
a single colossal shape.

Every smaller Whisperroot Colossus kneels.

Use !yes to enter the Cathedral or !no to leave before the forest itself
stands completely upright.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw while the enormous roots continue shifting behind you.
The Cathedral remains half forest, half creature.

boss.revealText:
The oldest roots tear free from the seabed as an immense guardian
stands over the Deeps.

Forest-Heart Colossus reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Forest-Heart Colossus lowers itself back into the ancient roots.

Within moments, the Cathedral looks like part of the landscape again.

You now trust landscapes considerably less."
